propositions: When a bug is closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates link, the gate falls through to the completion verifier which synthesizes a false resolution claim and fails, offering only impossible remediation paths (finishing unfinished work or false attestation) while never naming the actual fix (rebar link command).

The close_precheck must raise CommandError before any LLM call when close_class is duplicate and _has_live_replacement_link returns False, with the error message containing the exact rebar link command and the ticket id.
The gate must accept a duplicates link whose target is closed; link existence is required but target openness is not.
When a duplicates link names an archived or unresolvable target, the error must distinguish that dead-target case from the no-link-recorded case with different messages.
Classes not_a_bug, escalated, and non-disposition classes must fall through unchanged to the completion path when no replacement link exists.
